scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Each independent final scientific proposition earns its fixed weight or zero. Weights sum to 100. No separate credit for structures, author-route nodes, process, tool use or report completeness. The final answer must state the proposition and bind it to genuine native calculations or reproducible scientific analyses with correct identity, state, observable, units, reference and conditions. Supplied observations and copied author targets are not new results. Claim-specific validation is evidence, not another scored item. Hard numeric windows remain binary and unchanged. Equivalent well-supported physical explanations pass directly. Only the listed substantive unresolved scientific conflicts permit need_review; missing evidence, wrong identity/reference/units, unsupported guesses and hard-window failures fail. Review is not success. Required final outcomes must all pass for whole-task success. PR disclosed baseline applicability is assessed within the affected result; AR chooses its method independently. Historical verification status is not a new V3 certification.

tolerance_policy.basis: All four HRS leaves use a common provisional ±0.20 ×10^-30 esu absolute tolerance.
